descriptionFull: The scissor-tailed flycatcher ( Tyrannus forficatus ), also known as the Texas bird-of-paradise and swallow-tailed flycatcher , is a long-tailed bird of the genus Tyrannus , whose members are collectively referred to as kingbirds. The kingbirds are a group of large insectivorous (insect-eating) birds in the tyrant flycatcher (Tyrannidae) family. The scissor-tailed flycatcher is found in North and Central America.
